blindnessBoundary.note: This session never read pilot-001 artifacts, CC-24-PILOT-001-PA-REVIEW.md, historical benchmarks, or any other blindness-boundary-excluded material. All local reads were routed through the pilot guard (see PILOT-ACCESS-AUDIT.json); a separate runtime self-test additionally proved the guard denies unauthorized paths (see record-access-audit.ts console output), without persisting synthetic denials into the access-audit file.

producerParameterisation: pilot-guard.ts, freeze-selection.ts, and record-access-audit.ts were parameterised via a PILOT_ID environment variable (default "pilot-001", unchanged for any existing caller) to target this run's own output directory and experiment id without reading or modifying pilot-001. record-access-audit.ts was additionally corrected to stop persisting its denial self-test's DENIED records into PILOT-ACCESS-AUDIT.json, so that the validator's unconditional any-DENIED-invalidates-the-run check reflects a genuine unauthorized read if it ever fires, rather than always failing on pilot-001's own synthetic proof-of-denial entries.
